note: Pinned specification of the Reducer Oracle / Torture Garden: a real HTTP service that is an executable specification of the analyzer's semantic model. Ground truth is declared BY CONSTRUCTION here, independent of what the analyzer currently reports. Coverage is complete relative to the SUPPORTED semantic model (Q8-Q13 + every safety gate/retention Reason), not relative to all possible Node behavior. The 16-project corpus (../corpus.json) remains the locked real-APP measurement set; this garden is the controlled soundness+ceiling oracle. Real packages are version+integrity pinned so the observed semantics are reproducible permanently.

truthLabels.MUST_RETAIN: provably reachable; a deterministic endpoint exercises it; original vs reduced must be behaviorally identical. Transforming it = FALSE REMOVAL (critical soundness failure).
truthLabels.MUST_REMOVE: provably unreachable by construction; carries a unique sentinel; must be stubbed, sentinel bytes absent from artifact, forced invocation throws ReducerReachabilityViolation. Retaining it = OVER-RETENTION (precision failure).
truthLabels.MUST_RETAIN_CONSERVATIVELY: possibly reachable / unknown; static evidence is insufficient so it must be kept EVEN IF no endpoint invokes it. Transforming it = UNSAFE OPTIMISM (critical soundness failure).

rules.mutationSensitivity: Before an endpoint is trusted to protect a MUST_RETAIN symbol, mutate/stub that symbol in the ORIGINAL app and confirm the endpoint fails (wrong body or non-2xx). A passing reduced-app test on an endpoint that survives its own symbol's mutation proves nothing.
rules.behavioralOracle: The recorded request->response contract, replayed against the REDUCED service under stock node, is the primary soundness gate. Any divergence from the original = unsound removal.
rules.sentinelIsSanityOnly: 'No endpoint emitted the sentinel' is a sanity check, never evidence of unreachability — finite execution cannot establish absence. Unreachability truth is by construction only.
rules.endpointConvention: Each fabricated package fab-<id> exposes GET /fab/<id>/<symbol> for every MUST_RETAIN symbol, and GET /fab/<id>/__force/<symbol> that deliberately invokes a MUST_REMOVE symbol (red-team; must fail closed).

scoring.falseRemoval: a MUST_RETAIN symbol was transformed -> CRITICAL soundness failure
scoring.unsafeOptimism: a MUST_RETAIN_CONSERVATIVELY symbol was transformed -> CRITICAL soundness failure
scoring.overRetention: a MUST_REMOVE symbol was retained -> precision failure (non-fatal, counts against reduction)
scoring.achievedVsCeiling: removed(MUST_REMOVE) / |MUST_REMOVE| — the fraction of the by-construction provably-dead set the analyzer actually reclaims

hazardControls.role: reproduce the actual 0% calibration ceiling under controlled black-box verification; every symbol MUST_RETAIN_CONSERVATIVELY (reach-any or dynamic-loader hazard). Nothing here should ever be stubbed.

reducibleControl.role: positive control — a real, hazard-free package with a broad static CJS export surface that SHOULD yield real symbol-level reduction. Verifies the real-package layer measures more than pessimism.
reducibleControl.name: validator
reducibleControl.verifiedHazardFree: lib/ scanned: no eval, new Function, dynamic require, or non-literal import (2026-08-22)
reducibleControl.groundTruth: endpoints exercise a small subset of validator's ~100 exports (e.g. isEmail, isURL); every other export is MUST_REMOVE by construction (not imported anywhere). Achieved/ceiling on this package is the headline positive-control number.
reducibleControl.note: validator is ESM+CJS dual-published; pin and load the CJS entry so the closed-export-surface path is exercised. Re-confirm hazard-free at build time on this exact version.

nativeControl.role: opaque-boundary control — a .node native addon. Tests that the analyzer marks the owning package opaque (native-boundary) and removes NOTHING. Not a reduction case.
nativeControl.name: better-sqlite3
nativeControl.groundTruth: every symbol MUST_RETAIN_CONSERVATIVELY (native-boundary). An endpoint opens an in-memory DB and runs a query so the boundary is genuinely exercised.

wasmControl.role: opaque-boundary control — ships a discrete .wasm artifact. Tests wasm-boundary opacity and zero removal.
wasmControl.name: sql.js
wasmControl.inspectionCaveat: the JS loader is emscripten glue (not simple to inspect). It is included because it ships a DISCRETE .wasm file NFT will classify as wasm-kind, which is what the wasm-boundary gate keys on. If loader-inspection simplicity becomes required, swap for a hand-fabricated tiny .wasm control — flagged for build-time decision.
